prompt:
Paint ONE place into this tile of a painted grand-strategy map. The input is the finished map around the place, seen straight down; the place stands at the exact CENTRE of the image.

The place: Xuyên Lâm Môn, minor seat. Paint it as a minor sect's seat: a compact walled compound of halls and one tall pagoda or tower, terraces where the land climbs.
How it looks: On a high shoulder of Kinh Trập Sơn above the rain forest, a sect gate of plain grey stone stands at the head of a long stair that drops straight into the trees. Beside it an open-sided gatehouse holds racks of worn hardwood guide staffs, one taken down for every traveller led through the forest. Above the gate, small halls climb the ridge on narrow terraces.
Art brief: A minor sect seat miniature on a steep forested mountain shoulder: small grey-stone halls with dark grey tile roofs stacked up a ridge on narrow terraces, a short pagoda at the top as the tallest element. At the bottom, a plain grey stone gate at the head of a long straight stair descending into dense green canopy, and beside it the signature, an open-sided gatehouse lined with racks of upright wooden staffs. Rain mist in the trees below. Warm golden-hour light from the top left. No text, no figures larger than specks, nothing outside the footprint.

Rules:
- Paint the place as a small, finely detailed miniature, as if a model-maker had built it into this painted relief: seen from above at a gentle angle so roofs, walls and towers read clearly, its base sitting naturally on the terrain that is there (follow the slopes, the shore, the river).
- Keep it centred and compact: the whole place fits inside a circle about 20 % of the image width across the centre. Short roads or paths may lead out of it.
- Match the map exactly: the same golden-hour light from the TOP LEFT with soft shadows to the bottom right, the same painterly style, colours and level of detail as the surrounding terrain; the building scale fits the trees and hills around it.
- Leave everything outside that central circle exactly as it is in the input.
- Never: text, labels, banners with writing, flags with symbols, people larger than specks, a frame, a vignette, clouds over the place.
